module: Flowgraph node "Set Wind" (category once_p_duration). Applies wind to one vehicle or to all. Input pins: vehId (empty = all vehicles), windSpeed (m/s) and windDir (vec3, {1,0,0} by default). Every frame, sends obj:setWind(x,y,z) (direction multiplied by speed) to the vehicle VM. Resets the wind to zero on reset and on stop.
notes: The windDir vector is scaled without being normalized: a non-unit direction changes the actual speed.

work.desc: Computes windDir * windSpeed and sends it via queueLuaCommand to each affected vehicle.
